description: Lists the shared drives (formerly Team Drives) the authorized user is a member of: id, name, createdTime, plus nextPageToken. Use a drive's id as drive_id in search_files to browse its contents, or as parent_id to list its root. name_contains filters by name. My Drive is not a shared drive and never appears here.

name_contains.description: Only shared drives whose name contains this substring.

name: list_shared_drives
title: List shared drives
